INSERT INTO mk_ca_cf_mp_pq (dist_code, wo_no, area_code, amt_ym, other_col)
SELECT
    
    CASE WHEN random() < ? THEN ? ELSE lpad((floor(random()*?)::int)::text,?,?) END AS dist_code,
    
    ? || lpad((floor(random()*?)::int)::text,?,?) AS wo_no,
    
    ? || lpad((floor(random()*?)::int)::text,?,?) AS area_code,
    
    (ARRAY[?,?,?,?,?,?])[floor(random()*?)+?] AS amt_ym,
    
    ? || md5(random()::text) AS other_col
FROM generate_series(?, ?);
CREATE INDEX idx_mk_ca_cf_mp_pq_wo_ac ON mk_ca_cf_mp_pq (wo_no) global;

CREATE TABLE mk_ca_cf_mp_pq (
    dist_code    TEXT,
    wo_no        TEXT,
    area_code    TEXT,
    amt_ym       TEXT,
    other_col    TEXT
)
DISTRIBUTE BY HASH(dist_code)
PARTITION BY RANGE (amt_ym) (
    PARTITION p202601 VALUES LESS THAN ('202602'),
    PARTITION p202602 VALUES LESS THAN ('202603'),
    PARTITION p202603 VALUES LESS THAN ('202604'),
    PARTITION p202604 VALUES LESS THAN ('202605'),
    PARTITION p202605 VALUES LESS THAN ('202606'),
    PARTITION p202606 VALUES LESS THAN ('202607'),
    PARTITION p_max VALUES LESS THAN (MAXVALUE)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_mk_ca_cf_mp_pq_wo_ac ON mk_ca_cf_mp_pq (wo_no) LOCAL;
